<b>Shell Shards</b> are a collectible in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
=== Tools ===
Shell Shards are used to replenish the stock of {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} that [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] uses alongside her [[Needle]]. The number of Shell Shards needed varies by Tool.

Unless the [[Architect Crest]] is equipped, [[Tools]] can only be replenished when resting at a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]]. With the Architect Crest, Hornet can Craft Bind to replenish tools anywhere, for the same number of Shell Shards they would normally cost.

Hornet begins the game with a maximum capacity of {{S|400}}, which can be increased to a maximum of {{S|800}} by collecting [[Tool Pouch]] upgrades.

=== Wishes ===
Shell Shards are used to complete three [[Donate Wishes]] in [[Bone Bottom]]:

* [[Bone Bottom Repairs]] {{S|200}}
* [[A Lifesaving Bridge]] {{S|300}}
* [[An Icon of Hope]] {{S|440}}

== How to Acquire ==
[[File:Shard deposit.png|right|150x150px]]
Shell Shards can be gained in several different ways:
* Most [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] drop Shell Shards upon death. 
** A random 0%/25%/50% bonus (rounding up, with a maximum of 8 shards)<ref name=logic><code>HealthManager.Die()</code>.</ref> is added. The chances are 37.5%/37.5%/25% respectively.<ref><code>HealthManager._shellShardMultiplierArray</code>.</ref>
** The [[Shard Pendant]] tool increases yield (including the bonus)<ref name=logic /> by 25%.

* Shell Shards can be found in natural deposits.
** Alongside breakable fossils, many deposits feature fossilised surfaces that can be hit with a chance to get {{S|0-2}}. The chances are 80%/15%/5% respectively.<ref><code>ShardRegion.dropChances</code>.</ref> When the [[Architect Crest]] is equipped, the chances are 80%/5%/1.6%.<ref><code>ShardRegion.architectProbabilities</code>.</ref>
** Destroying small, round fossils often found in clusters grants {{S|5}}.
** Destroying large, ammonite-like fossils found individually grants {{S|33}}, excluding those in [[Wisp Thicket]], where they drop only {{S|24}}.
** Destroying fossilised coral conches found in [[Sands of Karak]] and in its section in the [[Memorium]] grants {{S|8}}. The speleothems in the eastern [[Underworks]] and on the roof of the [[Pale Lake]] drop the same amount of shards.
** Hitting fossilised growths in [[Shellwood]] causes them to drop and scatter into {{S|9}}.
** Destroying fossils merged with [[Flintstone]] found in the [[Deep Docks]] grants {{S|12}}.
* Shell Shards can be found in containers and artificial structures.
** Destroying Shell Shard barrels in the [[Deep Docks]], the [[Underworks]], the [[Grand Gate]], the [[Choral Chambers]], and above [[the Stage]] grants {{S|16}}.
** Destroying Shell Shard chests in the [[Underworks]], the [[Whispering Vaults]], and the [[High Halls]] grants {{S|15}}.
** Destroying Shell Shard strings in [[Hunter's March]] and the [[Far Fields]] grants {{S|9}}.
** Destroying regular heat lamps in [[Mount Fay]] grants {{S|0-2}}, while large ones grant {{S|3-4}}.
** The statue built by [[Flick the Fixer]] after completing the <i>[[An Icon of Hope]]</i> [[wish]] can be broken for {{S|38}}. Once destroyed, the ground below it can be hit to get {{S|0-2}}, functioning similarly to the fossilised surfaces of natural deposits.
* Several items can be broken into Shell Shards.
** Breaking a [[Shard Bundle]] grants {{S|80}}.
** Breaking a [[Beast Shard]] grants {{S|140}}.
** Breaking a [[Pristine Core]] grants {{S|220}}.
** Breaking the [[Hornet Statuette]] grants {{S|60}}.
** Breaking the {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Growstone]] grants {{S|30-45}} (Growth Stage 2), {{S|75-95}} (Growth Stage 3), or {{S|120-140}} (Growth Stage 4).
* After installing the [[Crawbell]] in the [[Bellhome]], [[Craws]] start to bring {{S|5-20}} every 300 seconds that pass in-game, with a maximum capacity of {{S|300-500}}. The maximum capacity is randomly selected again every time the nest's contents are collected.
